name: Optical Feedback Loop
description: Infinite optical feedback tunnel with a time-correct spring-damped pointer, multi-front ripple shockwaves and per-band spectral hue rotation that separates the tunnel into rings. Fixes two serious bugs: u.config.y (the ripple count) was used as delta time, freezing the spring and hue when no clicks were alive and exploding the integrator when they were; and nine state values were written into extraBuffer[0..8], the engine's bass/mid/treble/historyHead and FFT bins, corrupting the audio every other shader reads. State now lives in extraBuffer[133..135].

updatedParams.name: Accumulation Rate
updatedParams.description: How strongly each frame accumulates into the feedback buffer.

updatedParams.name: Feedback Zoom
updatedParams.description: Per-frame scale step of the tunnel.

updatedParams.name: Rotation
updatedParams.description: Per-frame rotation of the feedback transform.

updatedParams.description: Global hue rotation, layered over the per-band spectral rings.
